• Pixel 11 series

Four new Pixel 11 models are expected, including the standard 11, 11 Pro, 11 Pro XL, and foldable 11 Pro Fold, all featuring high-end displays, advanced cameras, and Tensor G6 processors.

The Pixel Watch 5 will introduce Atrial Fibrillation detection, improved health tracking, and a Snapdragon Wear W5 Gen 2 chipset, with larger batteries and doubled storage.
